mentions.name: AI WorkDeck
mentions.description: AI WorkDeck is an IDE for document-heavy workers, aiming to accelerate long-form document work the way code IDEs accelerate engineers. It is designed for users who spend their days in tools like MS Word that are not built for writing long documents.
mentions.problem: Engineers have IDEs that greatly accelerate their efficiency, but document workers like lawyers deal with MS Word daily even though it is not designed for writing long docs.
mentions.audience: Document-heavy workers such as lawyers who write long documents every day.
mentions.source_excerpt: AI WorkDeck, An IDE for Document Heavy Workers.
